options.description: Asks with plain lines in and lines out rather than a region that redraws, for a screen reader: the question is written once, what is typed is echoed where it is typed, and nothing already written is ever moved or erased.
options.name: accessible

options.description: What the `true` state is called. Defaults to `on`.
options.name: active

options.description: Whether Escape leaves the prompt to go back a step. Defaults to `false`, where Escape does nothing, as it always has.
options.name: back

options.description: What the `false` state is called. Defaults to `off`.
options.name: inactive

options.description: The state the prompt starts in. Defaults to `false`, which is the left-hand one.
options.name: initial

options.description: The input router to read keys through. One is built if not given.
options.name: router

options.description: Gives the prompt up when this aborts, the way Ctrl-C does.
options.name: signal

options.description: Where keys come from. Defaults to the terminal's input.
options.name: stdin

options.description: An answer to start from: the state the prompt opens in, which beats `initial`. A value that is not a boolean is dropped rather than refused, since it is an answer handed back rather than an option somebody wrote.
options.name: value

registryDescription: A toggle prompt: a setting with two named states, flipped with the arrows, Tab or Space
